trans-unit.source: This can only be done with the magical sword of time, huh...?
trans-unit.target: This can only be done with the magical sword of time, huh...?

trans-unit.source: I believe it is necessary to prevent Dhaos from retreating to another time.
trans-unit.target: I believe it is necessary to prevent Dhaos from retreating to another time.

trans-unit.source: If he fled again, we would have to start over again.
trans-unit.target: If he fled again, we would have to start over again.

trans-unit.source: Then we need to get that sword made, somehow!
trans-unit.target: Then we need to get that sword made, somehow!
